failedAssertions.reason: Unauthenticated projects/builds/deployments/domains returned 401, but contract route families for billing and/or metrics did not; see evidence.
Only 1 of 8 claimed language strategies built successfully with the expected strategy names in the live environment.
The SSE log stream did not capture the full required event set on the live build.
Deployment create returned 202 and final status succeeded with deployment.status='starting', runtimeEndpoint='', domainBindingPresent=True.
One or more exercised mutating endpoints did not consistently expose the expected async operation envelope or failure object contract.
Valid source upload returned 202 and completed succeeded; invalid file type returned 202.
Artifact upload returned 201 with an immediate build payload, and the stored build later appeared as buildStrategy='uploaded_artifact' instead of the expected prebuilt_wasm operation result.
Deployment listing statuses were all=200 filtered=200; filtered match present=True.
Delete returned 404 then None; runtime after delete returned None.
Failed build status='failed'; deployment attempt returned 202.
Duplicate slug rejection did not match the expected failed-operation conflict behavior.
Expected OAuth start 302 to GitHub authorize with client_id, redirect_uri, scope, and matching state cookie; observed http=302 location='http://localhost:8080/app?git=github_oauth_not_supported'.

The browser-reachable /get-started deployment workspace rendered as signed out with zero projects/builds/deployments, so the deployment form could not be completed against a real built artifact and no deployment result card or log modal was reached.

blockedAssertions.blockedBy: No actual timeout-enforced failure was demonstrated: janus-build does not set JANUS_BUILD_TIMEOUT_SEC, so the live stack is using the 15 minute default timeout from workflow.go. Triggering a >15 minute intentional stall was not performed in this shared validator batch.
Blocked: the localhost OAuth start route did not initiate GitHub authorization or set callback state, so a legitimate callback exchange could not be attempted.

appliedUpdates.description: Added e2e-pipeline concurrency guidance plus API isolation notes for build/deploy-heavy validator batches.
Recorded live validation knowledge for e2e-pipeline: known-good repo import sample, known unsupported-language sample, artifact upload response shape, and current /get-started auth instability.
